description: This file contains the implementation of the Note data model and a StorageService class for managing notes in an SQLite database. It includes methods for CRUD operations, listing, searching, and archiving notes, and defines the Note dataclass with serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A data class representing a note entity with fields like id, title, content, tags, archived status, creation, and update timestamps. Includes static method for creating a Note from a database row and a method to convert a Note to a dictionary.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with an SQLite database for storing, retrieving, updating, deleting, archiving, and searching notes.

methods.name: str _now_iso()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time in ISO 8601 format without timezone.

methods.name: Note.from_row
methods.description: Creates a Note instance from a sqlite3.Row object.

methods.name: Note.to_dict
methods.description: Converts the Note instance into a dictionary suitable for serialization.

methods.name: StorageService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the storage service, configuring the database path and ensuring the database and table exist.

methods.name: StorageService._get_conn
methods.description: Provides a new database connection with row factory set to return Row objects.

methods.name: StorageService._init_db
methods.description: Creates the notes table if it does not exist.

methods.name: StorageService.list_notes
methods.description: Returns a list of notes matching optional filters and paginated according to parameters.

methods.name: StorageService.get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: StorageService.create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note record in the database from provided data.

methods.name: StorageService.update_note
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new data and returns the updated note.

methods.name: StorageService.delete_note
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning True if deletion was successful.

methods.name: StorageService.soft_archive
methods.description: Marks a note as archived without deleting it.

methods.name: StorageService.search
methods.description: Performs a simple text search across notes' title, content, and tags with pagination support.
